title: Celestin's band at the Tranchina's nightclub
summary: Celestin led a strong dance band with the Marrero boys, played straight horn, and was a gentleman.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I thought you asked me about Celestan's band. Now you see Celestan, when he had that band at the Tux, at the Trenchinas? Mm-hmm. He had a better band then than he had when they were creating all this hubbub about him.

He had those Marrero boys, the bass player and the guitar man, and man, they set a tempo and that was it. They really had a dance band. I didn't like the way the popular band played, but out there he really had a nice band. They used to play opposite the Tokyo guard at Trenchinas nightclub. And they were celebrated, and they were known all over. but as a man, as a person, he was a grand old man. I know him well. He used to come, he liked to fish.
What about his second trumpet? Did he have a second trumpet out there? No.
Just him. Just him. But he used to play a straight horn. Just a straight horn. You know a boy sounds nice with two trumpets? Shocking.
I never heard him with two trumpets. Oh, man.

You ought to hear him with two trumpets. He let somebody play a lead, you know? I played with him like that, and I know. He sounds fine with Leon. Leon plays a nice lead. Now, Prima. And they all play as a nice drive. A nice one.
